values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

note: A gravel pull-through beside Loyalsock Road, listed as full sun. The agency says the site was not designed for RVs and its campsite map layer calls it a wooded tent or small trailer/RV site; listed as 60 by 30 ft. The Iron Bridge on Rock Run Road has been closed to vehicles since September 2026 (replacement expected in 2029), so the site cannot be reached from the PA 154 side of Rock Run Road: the agency says to come by Loyalsock Road off PA 154 below Worlds End State Park, or from the PA 87 side of Rock Run Road, and warns that some map apps show Loyalsock Road wrongly. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
